csv_project_name: AE Service for Pottstown Ricketts Community Center Project
csv_scope_of_work: The Borough of Pottstown, PA (hereafter Borough ) invites the submittal of responses to this Request for Proposals (hereafter RFP ) from qualified firms interested in providing professional engineering and architectural interior design services to advance work associated with execution of grant-funded interior remodeling and restoration and exterior accessibility improvements at the Richard J Ricketts Sr. Community Center, Pottstown. The selected firm will be required to perform the following: A. Complete updated site survey B. Assess structural needs and limitations of facility C. Design improvements to address identified needs D. Participate in two public design input meetings. E. Draft construction specifications and bid documents for all work. F. Complete permitting process G. Administer Bid and Tabulation Process. H. Administer Construction Contract and Construction.
csv_disciplines_requested: Architecture Services, Interior Design/Space Planning, Rehabilitation & Refurbishment
